Nigerian Mass Wedding Unites 1,500 Couples Amid Financial Hardship

A mass wedding ceremony in Kano State, Nigeria, saw 1,500 couples marry over two days. The event was organized by the state government to assist individuals who face financial difficulties in affording traditional weddings. As part of the initiative, each bride received a dowry of 200,000 Nigerian Naira. One widower, who lost his wife and six children in an attack, was among those who remarried at the event.
